One team, sketch to keys

Homes lose something between the architect's drawing and the contractor's site. We keep both jobs in one team, so nothing gets lost.

Beyond Conceptz designs and builds independent houses, villas and interiors. The person who sets a proportion on paper is the person who checks it on site.

We take on a limited number of homes at a time, so each one has an engineer's attention at every stage, and you always know who to call.

What we do for you

Take the complete service, or hire us for the one part you need. Each is scoped and priced before work starts.

Planning and design

  • A layout shaped around your plot, its light and the way your family lives, revised with you until every room is right.

    • Floor plans, with Vastu alignment if you want it
    • 3D elevation and a model you can turn
    • Approval and structural drawings

  • Foundation to final coat, built by our own team to the specification you signed.

    • Engineer checks before every concrete pour
    • Electrical, plumbing and waterproofing
    • Photos and video at every stage

  • Planned with the architecture, so storage, light and furniture sit where the plan meant them to.

    • Modular kitchen and wardrobes
    • Lighting, ceiling and pooja room
    • Furniture and styling

  • Add a floor or rework an older home. We check the existing structure first and tell you plainly what it can carry.

  • Workspaces, cafés and restaurants in Chennai, from layout to fit-out, delivered to a fixed opening date.

  • Already have a contractor? We prepare your plans, elevation and approval drawings, and visit site at key stages.

All services in detail

See it before it is built

Every home we design comes with a 3D model you can turn on your phone. You check the proportions, the shade from each overhang and how the floors stack while changes still cost nothing.

  • Front elevation and massing in 3D
  • A floor-by-floor view of the layout
  • Revised with you until it feels right

Three collections, in writing

Every collection comes with a written specification: the brand, grade and allowance for each material. Pick one as a starting point and we adjust it to your home.

Essential₹2,100 – 2,400 per sq.ftA well-built family home with dependable brands and a clean finish. Signature₹2,500 – 2,900 per sq.ftOur most chosen home, with teak joinery, larger tiles and a fuller kitchen. Bespoke₹3,100 – 3,800 per sq.ftDesigner finishes, system windows and details chosen with you.
